objective: What are the best practices, frameworks, and emerging 2025-2026 trends for: (1) the creative strategist role in DTC e-commerce paid advertising - job description, skills needed, compensation, career ladder, (2) client acquisition for freelance creative strategists specifically on Upwork and LinkedIn - portfolio building, proposal writing, outreach templates, (3) the concept of 'paid to feel' or 'monetizing taste and judgment' in the AI era - how creative professionals leverage AI for production while selling human judgment, (4) Meta Andromeda algorithm changes and what they mean for creative diversity and ad testing strategy, (5) building a proof portfolio as a freelance copywriter or creative strategist - case studies, testimonials, track record documentation
